Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the standard of evidence for appeals of valuation of property for purposes of taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the standard of evidence for appeals ofvaluation of property for purposes of taxation; amending RCW84.40.0301; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.40.0301 and 1994 c 301 s 35 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Upon review of a determination by a board of equalization orthe board of tax appeals of the valuation of property for purposes oftaxation, it is presumed that the determination of the public officialcharged with the duty of establishing such value is correct, but thispresumption is not a defense against any correction indicated by apreponderance of the evidence. (2) Upon review by any court((, or appellate body,)) of adetermination of the valuation of property for purposes of taxation, it((shall be)) is presumed that the determination of the public officialcharged with the duty of establishing such value is correct but thispresumption ((shall)) is not ((be)) a defense against any correctionindicated by clear, cogent, and convincing evidence.
This act applies to taxes levied forcollection in 2012 and thereafter.
